Is100 

Open Softwear “Flow Sight” you should hear some mechanical noises

Run beads 

Qc beads are left at room temp in drawer nex to the canto. No need to dilute, just use 1 drop.  

Load the beads, click “OK” (qc beads will take a long time)  

Open fluidics, make sure it is selected on the middle bar  

Click “start all calibrations”  

YOU WANT ALL TESTS TO BE GREEN  

Yellow is a warning  

Red is not good 

IF RED: click on the individual red tests to re-run THAT test. Onlt try 3 times, if it is still failed there is “no hope”, inform Dr. Fan
